entries.name: icon-attack
entries.prompt: Command icon for a strategy-game button: a single upright medieval arming sword, antique gold and pale steel, slight bevel and inner glow, drawn as a clean readable symbol with strong silhouette, centered, filling 80% of a square. Background: flat uniform very dark navy #141A24 (no gradient). Icon style: semi-realistic painted, consistent with a set of 15 icons. Style: realistic medieval strategy-game art, painterly realism with crisp detail, warm late-afternoon sunlight from the upper left, golden-ochre and olive tones, muted dusty greens, soft long shadows, slight atmospheric haze. Match the attached reference image exactly in palette, lighting and brushwork. No text, no watermark, no logos.

entries.name: unit-sheet-archer
entries.prompt: Character reference sheet of a medieval archer for a 3D model: the same figure shown three times side by side, full body, arms slightly away from the body, front view, side view, back view. The character is the man from the attached portrait: leather cap, padded olive gambeson with a cobalt-blue tabard (team colour #1F5FBF), brown trousers, leather boots, quiver on the back, longbow in the left hand. Painterly-realistic style with crisp detail, warm neutral lighting, no cast shadows, clean readable silhouette. IMPORTANT: the entire background is one flat, uniform, pure chroma-key green #00FF00 with absolutely no scenery, no ground, no sky, no gradient. No text.
